name: Quantoz EURQ
oneLiner: EURQ is Quantoz Payments' MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin from a Dutch EMI, redeemable 1:1 against segregated euro cash and short-dated government bonds.
collateral: Euro-denominated cash deposits and government bonds held in segregated reserves with reserve ratio disclosed on Quantoz's transparency page

review.evidence: Ethereum (2026-05-25): owner 0x284Df7B9 3/5 HadronMultisig, proxy admin 0xa6724f79 3/5; Polygon block 88323602: owner 0x84e8d731 3/5, proxy admin 0x2f875fa2 3/5. XRPL issuer account confirmed (no signer list, master key enabled). Algorand ASA 2768422954 manager/freeze confirmed as issuer-operated accounts. All addressable mint-capable surfaces confirmed; XRPL and Algorand issuer-backend corroborated by Quantoz EMI issuance model. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No public dated independent EURQ reserve-to-liability report was located; Quantoz provides a live issuer dashboard and generic periodic-audit claims without a named attestor, cadence, or latest artifact. The DNB public register exactly matches Quantoz Payments B.V. as an electronic-money institution and EURQ EMT issuer, providing prudential supervision.

reserveReview.rationale: Quantoz's June 30 reserve overview reports EURQ at 34% allocated cash and 66% government bonds, with a 100.66% reserve ratio. The EURQ whitepaper confirms that at least 30% is held in separate bank accounts and the remainder in secure, low-risk, highly liquid instruments; the dashboard identifies the bond issuers as the Netherlands, Germany, and United States.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Quantoz Reserve Status Overview updated June 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The two disclosed categories cover the full reserve allocation, but Quantoz does not identify individual banking partners, bond security identifiers, country weights, or a maximum maturity. Liquidity horizon therefore remains unknown for the government-bond bucket.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURQ is Quantoz-issued across multiple ledgers, and the reviewed issuer materials present it as a regulated fiat-backed EMT rather than a third-party bridge wrapper. The route is classified as issuer-native issuance/redemption.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena)

routes.reviewNote: Verified on Ethereum at block 25570711: EURQ token 0x8df723295214ea6f21026eeeb4382d475f146f9f is Quantoz's EIP-1967 upgradeable ERC-20 (symbol EURQ, 6 decimals; implementation 0xbae166f5e8b4b6735341446b1405fa779a92d7c7, proxy admin 0xa6724f792002d5677a7bc370986e1b580b8773e7), owner() = 0x284df7b9d9f471554e9257bd9b116189f7997d45, a 5-owner multisig with required() = 3 (getOwners/required verified). Quantoz's EURQ page lists this address as the official Ethereum issuance; EURQ is an e-money token issued by Quantoz Payments B.V. under a DNB e-money licence.

Verified on Polygon at block 90537833: EURQ token 0xd571edb2ef29df10fcd6200fd6d0ed2389983db3 is Quantoz's EIP-1967 upgradeable ERC-20 (symbol EURQ, 6 decimals; implementation 0x27858f66e09fe117f3c1d2ed98d8d6ca1a1d907c, proxy admin 0x2f875fa20c2b65fb7c6dc2671b870f2e7b84d7b8), owner() = 0x84e8d731fcbe186b803db51e9e58142083417929, a 5-owner multisig with required() = 3 (same signer set as the Ethereum EURQ multisig). Quantoz's EURQ page lists this address as the official Polygon issuance.

EURQ on XRPL is issued directly by Quantoz's issuer account rDk1xiArDMjDqnrR2yWypwQAKg4mKnQYvs (account_info via xrplcluster.com, validated ledger 2026-07-20: account active, defaultRipple enabled, globalFreeze not set). Quantoz's EURQ page lists this account as the official XRPL issuance; XRPL issued currencies are controlled by their issuer account by design.
